G00:M005.text: Oh, come to think of it... Have you seen my husband?
G00:M005.reason: Restaurar transición de recuerdo y referente marido.

G00:M017.text: Oh, sorry. The shop is not ready yet.
G00:M017.reason: Preparación de tienda, no inexistencia genérica de mercancía.

G00:M018.text: With my husband gone, we have nothing to sell.

G00:M021.text: I do not know where you got it. Will you sell it to me?
G00:M021.reason: No presupone compra previa; restaurar destinataria.

G00:M026.text: Thanks to all the items you bring back, the shop is doing well.
G00:M026.reason: Eliminar ffffff y mejorar sintaxis causal.

G00:M031.text: Papa was always so quiet and gentle...
G00:M031.reason: Otonashii/odayaka: tranquilo y afable, no maduro.

G00:M037.text: I wonder what will happen to {Atla}...
G00:M037.reason: Pregunta por destino futuro, no por hecho pasado.

G00:M044.text: Put the pot in a sunny spot.

G00:M045.text: Once you decide what to plant, put it in the pot. I will take care of it.
G00:M045.reason: Restituir instrucción de introducir semilla y cuidado.

G00:M055.reason: Kore de refiere al insumo, no al lugar.

G00:M057.text: Your bag is full. Why not store some items?
G00:M057.reason: Invitación a depositar fuera, no oferta de servicio local.

G00:M060.text: I am sorry I put you in danger.

G00:M061.text: After showing you the way, I dug up a purple crystal.
G00:M061.reason: Dug up preciso, no solo found.

G00:M065.text: Every heart has light and darkness. But the darkness must never take over.
G00:M065.reason: Restituir prohibición de inversión, no aclarar oscuridad.

G00:M067.text: I am lucky I was saved. And I am sorry.
G00:M067.reason: Sujeto salvado, no elogio de habilidad.

G00:M068.text: Now your friend has been possessed.

G00:M072.text: Lately, having a dungeon here has started to feel normal.

G00:M076.text: No one is possessed, yet the dungeon is still here. How strange.

G00:M081.text: No one is possessed, but the dungeon is still there. Why...?

G01:M003.text: Huh? If no one knows, the treasure is all ours!
G01:M003.reason: Restituir plural de posesión y lógica.

G01:M006.text: I got a room ready for you over here, {Poulet}!

G01:M013.text: If you have lots to store, use the storehouse. I have already spoken to them.

G01:M021.text: Hmm... First it was {Camilla's Dad}. When we got pushed off, it was {Janita}.
G01:M021.reason: Camilla papa es el padre de Camilla; restaurar empujón.

G01:M025.text: The crystal was so pretty. I wondered what it was, then got all confused.
G01:M025.reason: Confusión causada, no no recordar por qué.

G01:M026.text: Well, I have said sorry. While I was possessed, I saw an amazing vision.

G01:M027.text: In the knowledge of that crystal, there were lots of items unknown to us!

G01:M029.text: I do not know why, but the mayor was making a fuss.
G01:M029.reason: Sujeto alcalde haciendo alboroto, no buscar alcalde.

G01:M030.text: {Rask} next door seems to be fixing a worn-out machine.
G01:M030.reason: Next door, no dirección izquierda inventada.

G01:M032.text: {Rask} next door seems to be looking for another Card.

G01:M035.text: They are rare and useful. They may change how everyone lives.

G01:M036.text: If we keep selling items, we will become famous too!
G01:M036.reason: Juego de palabras fama, no comercializar nombres.

G01:M041.reason: Ii ya positivo, no pregunta despectiva.

G01:M045.text: What? You say you are fine? You can handle it?

G01:M053.text: Oh, man! No wonder you are all right.

G02:M001.text: I forgot where I put my precious ring. I am at a loss.
G02:M001.reason: Dejar, no dejar caer; valor sentimental y problema.

G02:M002.text: If only I had an item that could tell me where things are...

G03:M010.text: You are going to play in the dungeon with all those strange items, right?
G03:M010.reason: Oniichan tratamiento al protagonista, no hermano ausente.

G03:M012.reason: Wah confundía alegría; evitar hermano literal no demostrado.

G03:M013.text: Mom said not to play as a toad so much.
G03:M013.reason: No agrega fuentes ausentes en este mensaje.

G04:M003.text: That lively moogle went to the home of the mayor. I will start an unusual business soon. Come back then!

G04:M013.text: I used the Card without asking.

G04:M017.text: This machine mixes two hoes together to make a new hoe.
G04:M017.reason: Kuwa literal: broma de azadas antes de aclarar Talons.

G04:M031.text: I worry about {Camilla's Dad}, but I am curious about the dungeon too.
G04:M031.reason: Padre de Camilla; curiosidad, no preocupación por dungeon.

G04:M039.text: Thank you for all you do for {Rask}.
G04:M039.reason: Invertido agente de ayuda; fórmula de gratitud a interlocutor.

G04:M046.text: I made this on impulse, but I think you can use it.

G04:M047.text: It should carry one item somewhere above ground. If it works as planned, it will return to your house.
G04:M047.reason: Restituir incertidumbre, cantidad uno y destino planeado.

G04:M057.text: It has been a while! Children grow up so quickly.

G04:M062.text: Honestly! Who does he take after?
G04:M062.reason: Pregunta prepara respuesta Me; no frase rota.

G04:M065.text: Everyone is safe, but the dungeon remains.

G04:M066.text: The dungeon keeps my shop in business.

G04:M074.text: No, you need to have enough money.
G04:M074.reason: Requisito jugador, no necesidad del vendedor.

G00:M025.text: Honestly, Dad! Where did you go? We have nothing left to sell.
G00:M025.reason: Pérdida visible de out; conservar queja y mercancía agotada.

G00:M082.text: Dungeons grow from the desires of someone. Whose desires could these be...?
G00:M082.reason: Separar these are y recuperar expansión.

G01:M010.text: Oh, is there anything you want to leave here?
G01:M010.reason: Falta m en me; reformular sin pérdida.

G01:M034.text: {Poulet}, everyone is amazed by the items you bring back.

G01:M054.text: {Poulet}, next time, find a way to get back on your own.

G04:M007.text: Ahhh! Th-that Card! What is it?
G04:M007.reason: La pausa de tartamudeo elimina A en ejecución; reponer interjección legible.

G04:M020.text: Those Talons you have... Put two in, and they become a new pair.
G04:M020.reason: Separación Those Talons y naturalidad de resultado.

G04:M038.text: Nice to meet you! I am {Sania}.
G04:M038.reason: Separar presentación y nombre; mantener saludo de primer encuentro.
